3 Simple Food Swaps
1
Cold Drink / Soda→Nimbu Paani or Coconut Water
Saves ~150 kcal per glass. Reduces insulin spikes, kills skin breakouts, improves hydration.
2
White Rice (daily)→Moong Dal Khichdi or Bajra Roti
Higher protein, more fibre, slower digestion. Keeps fuller longer, reduces fat storage.
3
Biscuits / Chips→Makhana + Pumpkin Seeds
Low-cal, high-protein. Pumpkin seeds restore zinc — directly improves skin clarity.
💡 These 3 swaps alone can reduce 400–500 kcal daily without feeling like dieting.
